headerDisplay: Lennox S40 over local LCC. A Home mode change switches that zone onto manual schedule 16+zoneId (same path as lennoxs30api) and does not return it to the programmed schedule. Child bridge is config-only: Bridge Settings, then pair the child QR and delete the old tile.

host.title: Thermostat address
host.description: https://IP or hostname of the S40

resetOnBoot.title: Reset cached accessories on boot
resetOnBoot.description: Leave off. Turning this on creates new HomeKit/Grafana identities after every restart.
